issues.dependency: Site ownership, customer contracts, tariffs, capex and utilization
issues.consequence: All project cash-flow inputs remain illustrative; no issuer project return.

issues.dependency: Named project permit, phase MW, applicable authority conditions and service dates
issues.consequence: Policy examples and issuer updates cannot calibrate delay probabilities.

issues.dependency: Economic equipment life, tax basis, replacements and market-supported resale
issues.consequence: Finite-horizon and recovery assumptions can change scenario ranking.

issues.dependency: Gas supply, generation delivery, redundancy, emissions permissions and schedule
issues.consequence: Immediate alternative power is an assumption, not an executable option.

issues.dependency: Site-specific loss frequency, recoverability, liability and controls
issues.consequence: Cyber/operational results are conditional severity only, not expected annual losses.

issues.dependency: LBNL raw workbook and cohort details
issues.consequence: Summary arithmetic is reproduced; raw aggregation and duration distribution are not.

issues.dependency: Issuer-wide cash-flow bridge, current shares, price and expectations
issues.consequence: No stock recommendation, price target or mispricing estimate.
Software checks and AI review cannot establish human research approval.
